description: Fetch the people who reacted to a single LinkedIn post. Costs 1 credit per page of up to 100 reactions, walking up to max_pages pages (default 10), so at most max_pages credits; cached pages are free. The output's fetched / total_available / truncated fields say when the post had more reactions than were fetched. Engagers (with reaction kind) are persisted to the post_engagements graph so subsequent queries about who-engages-with-whom are SQL, not API calls.

max_pages.description: Max pages of up to 100 reactions to fetch (1-20, default 10). Each page costs 1 credit.

refresh.description: Bypass the cache and re-fetch from LinkedIn (costs 1 credit per page). Default false: previously-fetched pages are returned free, with how long ago they were retrieved.

name: linkedin_post_reactions
title: LinkedIn Post Reactions
